_comment: The auth-token contract: ONE answer key, four frameworks. ADR-0079.
What each framework accepts as proof of identity: a Frond form token is never
an identity, the HMAC secret is at least 32 bytes and never blank, debug is
switched on only by the operator, an unknown peer is never a local peer, and
request-scoped identity state (PHP's native session under a worker, a stored
SSO identity) does not outlive its request or its lifetime.
Each invariant names a REAL suite file per framework and a list of case names.
The suites carry the SAME case names in each language's idiom (Python
snake_case, PHP testPascalCase, Ruby it-description, Node assert label), which
scripts/audit-contract-fixtures.py normalises and matches. Real dispatch, real
Frond tokens, real HMAC, real sessions, real child-process boots, a real
Node has no `serve --production` flag and never defaulted debug on, so the
debug-is-explicit invariant names the three frameworks whose CLIs had the
defect. The PHP-only invariants cover PHP-only runtime paths (Swoole, PSR-7).

invariants.rule: A JWT whose type claim is "form" is refused by every identity gate: the route auth gate (Bearer, body formToken and session slots), the WebSocket upgrade gate, authenticate_request and the Bearer middleware helpers. A form token in one slot is skipped and the next slot is tried. The gate issues a FreshToken only after an identity token authenticated the request; refresh preserves purpose, so a refreshed form token is still a form token. The CSRF middleware keeps accepting form tokens. An auth token keeps passing every slot.
invariants.why: Form tokens and auth tokens are signed with the same TINA4_SECRET; the identity gates checked the signature and expiry but not the purpose.
cases: a form token in the bearer header is refused by the route gate
a form token in the body is refused by the route gate
a form token in the session is refused by the route gate
a form token in the body falls through to the session token
a form token is refused on a secured websocket upgrade
a form token is refused by authenticate request
refresh never issues a fresh token from a form token
an auth token still passes the route gate
a form token still passes csrf

invariants.rule: HMAC signing raises an error naming TINA4_SECRET and `openssl rand -hex 32` when the key is shorter than 32 bytes (blank included); HMAC verification with such a key rejects the token (401, never 500) and logs the same actionable message. The rule covers an explicit secret argument too. A server refuses to boot outside dev with a blank TINA4_SECRET and in any mode with a set-but-short one.
invariants.why: A blank key is publicly reproducible, so tokens signed or verified with it can be minted by anyone.
cases: signing with a blank secret is refused
signing with a secret shorter than 32 bytes is refused
a token forged with the empty key is rejected
a 32 byte secret signs and verifies
boot outside dev refuses a blank secret
boot outside dev refuses a short secret

invariants.rule: is_loopback("") is false: an empty or unknown peer address is a remote caller for the MCP and dev-admin loopback gates. Loopback addresses (127/8, ::1, ::ffff:127.x, localhost) still pass.
invariants.why: A runtime path that failed to pass its socket peer read as local and opened the loopback gates.
cases: an empty peer is not loopback
a loopback peer is loopback
an empty peer is refused by the mcp gate

invariants.rule: PHP only: App::__invoke passes the PSR-7 request's REMOTE_ADDR server param as the request's socket peer, and an absent one as '' (unknown), never a made-up loopback address.
invariants.why: PSR-7 runtimes (RoadRunner, FrankenPHP worker mode) run under the CLI SAPI, where $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] is never set.
cases: a psr7 request carries its real peer

invariants.rule: PHP only, on a REAL openswoole worker: a request carries its real socket peer, and one user's native $_SESSION is never visible to the next user, while each user's own session (native and Tina4) still resumes from its own cookie.
invariants.why: The router started the native session once per worker process and never closed it, and the Swoole branch dropped both the peer and the Cookie header.
cases: two users on a real swoole worker never share a native session
a swoole worker request carries its real peer

invariants.rule: A stored SSO identity authenticates only while its expires_at is in the future; expires_at 0 means the provider gave no lifetime and the identity lives as long as the session. Callback and refresh store 0 when the provider omits expires_in.
invariants.why: The route gate trusted the stored identity without reading expires_at.
cases: an expired sso identity is refused
a live sso identity passes

invariants.rule: A Frond form token lives TINA4_TOKEN_LIMIT minutes (default 60) in every framework: exp - iat == TINA4_TOKEN_LIMIT * 60 seconds.
invariants.why: Ruby passed minutes * 60 to an API that takes minutes, so a form token lived 60 hours.
cases: a form token lives token limit minutes

invariants.rule: The serve command honours TINA4_DEBUG from .env; --production turns debug off (the explicit flag beats the environment); a missing .env never enables debug and no framework writes TINA4_DEBUG=true or an API key into .env as a boot side effect.
invariants.why: Python's serve set TINA4_DEBUG=true before .env loaded and never read --production; PHP's and Ruby's --production only picked a server; Ruby wrote TINA4_DEBUG=true and a clock-derived API key into a missing .env.
cases: serve honours debug false from env file
production flag turns debug off
a missing env file does not enable debug
